comment.body:
It's unfathomable to me how so many people listening to someone relating there own experience -- and, as the ultimate authority on what happened in their experience, interpret their experience and explain it to us -- will get triggered and freak out, erase and dismiss the person, judge them as some shade of delusional, with absolutely no reason, facts, or evidence to support that judgment, but solely because what they're hearing is too strange for them to handle.

That alone is enough for these morons to judge what they're hearing as ridiculously untrue and scorn-worthy.

This applies to the shit-for-brains application of "conspiracy theory" to ideas that don't closely approximate what they've already decided is true and real, for no other reason than that the ideas don't fit their mold.

It's like they've decided that nothing can be real unless it's something they're already familiar with.

You realize that's a form of psychosis don't you? Not to mention the self-aggrandizement of insisting that reality must reduce itself to the little speck of experience they've had and the infinitesimally small bit of it they're capable of comprehending.

Why does the radically unfamiliar freak people out so badly that they can't bear to listen and must malign and dismiss it like a knee-jerk without any rational basis?

No wonder we've turned into a world of compulsive liars, when simply, honestly sharing our experiences, feelings, and understanding of them consistently serves as an invitation to be attacked and demeaned.

Sane people simply do not respond like that.

This is how I know that every single person who invokes "Conspiracy theory!" isn't just an idiot, but is suffering from a mental condition.

To all of you sad fucks who still do that:

Freaking out at no more than merely hearing information that is strange to you is not a normal, healthy, sane reaction.

To then malign, deride, marginalize, dismiss, and erase a human being on the basis of your triggered reaction is nothing short of evil.

Your grasp of things and your OCD defense of it are not more important than a human being and their grasp of things, you self-worshiping fool.

And pay attention to the huge, decisive, and undeniable difference between imagination xenophobes like you and people, like Dick here, simply relating to you what they've actually experienced.

He's not defending anything. (You can feel him stealing himself for the backlash he knows he's going to get, though.)

Nor is he attacking anything or anyone -- least of all you, flaming narcissist that you are.

It's not all about you, you know.

Nothing is all about you.

https://www.facebook.com/christina.estabrooks.1/videos/1975600966575210

comment.body:
We were taught that the world changes as a result of the actions of "leaders".

That's a lie, in the same way that saying MLK was responsible for Civil Rights would be a lie. MLK himself rejected the idea:

I’m tired of people crediting me with starting this movement. The Montgomery Bus Boycott would have happened without me. The people were ready.

— Martin Luther King Jr., as recalled by Coretta Scott King in My Life with Martin Luther King, Jr. (1969).

"Leaders" are just not how major change happens. They wage wars and genocides and tyrannies, they fleece and butcher their own people, but how is that "change"?

That's just the same old same-old fuckery.

Here is how change always occurs. It isn't until they see a major movement has progressed far enough to be reliable that hijackers and co-opters step in to claim credit.

And the tipping point? The point at which change has gone far enough to guarantee (statistically) that it will go near-total?

10%.

When the number of committed opinion holders is below 10 percent, there is no visible progress in the spread of ideas. It would literally take the amount of time comparable to the age of the universe for this size group to reach the majority," said SCNARC Director Boleslaw Szymanski, the Claire and Roland Schmitt Distinguished Professor at Rensselaer. "Once that number grows above 10 percent, the idea spreads like flame.

-- http://phys.org/news/2011-07-minority-scientists-ideas.html

People continually ask "How?"

This is how.

The "leaders" don't control the Overton Window. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Overton%20window)

WE do.

They can do nothing if we close the window to it.

They are at our mercy, always have been -- but holy shit! Just look at the snow job they pulled off, flipping it all upside-down, so that most people can't even IMAGINE THE TRUTH.

See the way it works here:

https://setosa.io/ev/exponentiation/#:~:text=The%20following%20is%20a%20naive%20model%20of%20the%20spread%20of%20a%20virus%20in%20a%20population.%20The%20number%20of%20infected%20individuals%20grows%20exponentially%20up%20until%20the%20virus%20runs%20out%20of%20people%20to%20infect.

The sad thing here -- and it's no different for any soldier anywhere, not in any war, ever -- isn't that he's starting to realize that he was disposable from the start: created to be used and discarded. 

The sad thing is that he's still so deluded, he continues to think his expectations mean something, that the government that created him as a tool to be used and scrapped accepts any responsibility or obligation to do any of the things he's demanding.

He protected a regime that never had any intention of protecting him. 

Most people who listen to him and sympathize or empathize with him will do so because they're still suffering under exactly the same delusion. 

The people who create, sustain, maintain, and fund military organizations do not have any human feeling towards our children whom they seduce with lies and conscript as fodder for their "glory". Of course they buffalo their codependent populations with the bullshit of the honor of dying for your country. Who would enlist otherwise?

Witness how powerful the mindfuck has been. Decade after decade, generation after generation, they've maintained the malignant myths of the glories of nationalism, patriotism, mass murder, mass rape, mass mayhem, massive destruction and deprivation, mass dehumanization, and contrived chaos, dignifying the most extreme psychotic crimes ever known to humankind as "war". 

They've convinced us that war is necessary and unavoidable. Right, and for whom? Mass murder, mass rape, mass mayhem, massive destruction and deprivation, mass dehumanization, and contrived chaos are necessary and unavoidable in order to **protect the parasite classes that depend on violence and war to maintain their positions of superiority and to compete for supreme control**.

No, none of this shit is necessary, unavoidable, or inevitable. Absolutely not. We could get rid of all of it by getting rid of the people who benefit and thrive on sucking the blood of our children means of it and other methods that are coming to light.

But this shit will continue as long as people demand to be codependents, like this broken soldier, looking for help and support and protection to the very people who profited from breaking him and exterminating his friends.

As long as we look to psychopaths as our "leaders" and "protectors", our children's blood and our own will continue to flow like rivers, and these self-exalted psychotics will continue to lap it up and laugh.
